messages:
nina.marketing: Quick sync idea  2-week "FastStart" launch: tiny OSS refkit, 3 snack tutorials, a reproducible perf note, and a webinar. Primary goals: GH traction, signups, and a bench narrative for the blog.

sam.devrel: Love it. Tutorials: Quickstart (10m), Latency & cost tips (12m), Canary rollouts (15m). Provide copy-paste snippets and a Docker dev image.

lee.eng: I'll run a compact perf harness on g6/g5. Tests: fp16 vs int4, seq=128, batch=1/4. ETA 30h. ci.bot: perf job queued for 04:30 UTC.

toni.content: I'll draft the launch post + two social threads (announce + technical). Need bench CSV and a short engineer quote.

mike.growth: For inbound: gated download with routing flows: paying customers -> acct-exec; enterprise-like leads -> SDR; OSS contributors -> devrel nurture; others -> marketing drip. We'll tune thresholds after 100 signups.

rebecca.sales: Proposed qualification: company_size >= 75 OR monthly_tokens >= 150k => SDR. Flag github_org or maintainer role as high-intent. Escalate "on-prem" mentions to AE.

nina.marketing: Messaging A/B options: A) "Refkit FastStart: ship LLM features with a tested starter" B) "Reproducible benchmarks, dev-friendly refkit" We'll A/B test hero and CTA.

sam.devrel: Add a mini-eval notebook and CONTRIBUTING.md so users can reproduce numbers and submit PRs. Also include a small maintainer welcome pack.

lee.eng: Bench snapshot: g6 int4 batch1 seq128 -> ~2.1x tokens/sec vs fp16 (full CSV + runbook to repo shortly).

toni.content: Got the snapshot. Draft will include model, seq len, batching, region, and repro link. Tone: developer-first and transparent.

mike.growth: Routing pseudocode draft:
```
if paying_customer:
  route = "acct_exec"
elif company_size >= 75 or monthly_tokens >= 150000:
  route = "sdr"
elif github_contrib == true or opensource_org == true:
  route = "devrel_nurture"
else:
  route = "marketing_drip"
```
Tune after initial cohort.

rebecca.sales: SDR playbook + 3 opening lines incoming.

nina.marketing: Action items: lee -> bench artifacts + runbook (24h), sam -> tutorials + vids (5d), toni -> post + social (48h), mike -> landing + routing (48h), rebecca -> SDR playbook (48h). Quick sync tomorrow to lock publish date. :rocket:
